name: epcis-event-check
description: EPCIS event check: reads a file of GS1 EPCIS 2.0 events in JSON or JSON-LD (an EPCISDocument with its events in epcisBody.eventList, an EPCISQueryDocument, or a JSON list of events) before they are written to a shared supply chain ledger, contacts no ledger, node or API, fetches nothing, writes nothing to a ledger and reads no clock, and lists with its line every data mistake the checks know: an event type EPCIS does not have, a missing or malformed eventTime, recordTime or time zone offset, a missing or wrong action or an action on a TransformationEvent, an event that names no object, parent or business transaction, a TransformationEvent with no inputs or outputs, a quantity that is not positive or a count with no unit, no readPoint or bizLocation, no bizStep, a bizStep or disposition that is not in the CBV, an eventID written twice or not at all, events out of order or later than --now, an EPC seen after it was deleted, shipped from a place it never reached or put in two parents, EPC URIs whose digits do not add up and GTIN, SSCC and GLN check digits that are wrong. Not a certification of conformance. Text, markdown, JSON and SARIF output, exit codes for a pipeline, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
